claims.value: BLG only, glucose, octanoic acid, or both at 0, 3, 6, 9, 12 hours

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Deamidated N/Q and Oxidation M variable; 7 ppm MS1, 20 ppm MS2
claims.evidence: Preprint Orthrus MS2 data analysis Methods explicitly states search settings. Deposited PSM output independently shows +15.9994 and +0.984 mass shifts in peptide strings; fixed C cannot be inferred from PSM output alone.

limitations: The blank incubation time is not identified by the three RAW filenames, so not available is used.
The preprint is not peer reviewed; its Methods are used for experimental design, cross-checked against PRIDE file names.
Search parameters are reported in the linked preprint Methods; no standalone parameter file is deposited. PSM output corroborates variable mass shifts but not fixed carbamidomethyl C or tolerances.
